after.hourglass/timesheet.py:
# owner: platform
"""Weekly timesheet lines built from a list of shifts."""

from hourglass.schedule import worker_minutes
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError
from collections import Counter


def _check(shifts):
    if not shifts:
        raise ProjectError("no shifts to report on")
    if any(not s.worker.strip() for s in shifts):
        raise ProjectError("shift has a blank worker name")

# ---
def timesheet_lines(shifts):
    """One line per worker, busiest (most hours) first."""
    shifts = list(shifts)
    _check(shifts)
    counts = Counter(s.worker for s in shifts)
    minutes = worker_minutes(shifts)
    order = sorted(minutes, key=lambda w: (-minutes[w], w))
    return [
        f"{w}: {counts[w]} shifts, {minutes[w] / 60:.1f} hours"
        for w in order
    ]
